papers.title: LeapQuant: Efficient Linear Attention with Accurate Recurrent State Quantization
papers.abstract: Recent LLMs increasingly adopt hybrid designs that replace standard attention with linear attention, such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN) and Kimi Delta Attention (KDA). Although they compress the context into a fixed-size recurrent state and substantially reduce the cost of long-context processing, repeatedly reading and updating that state remains a major inference bottleneck. Quantization offers a natural way to reduce this cost, but can significantly degrade model quality, due to the accumulation of
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.38166）：LeapQuant 解决 hybrid linear-attention LLM（明确点名 Gated DeltaNet / Kimi Delta Attention）部署时的核心 inference 瓶颈——recurrent state 反复读写的高代价与量化导致的模型质量退化。提出 accurate recurrent state quantization，在 state read/update 过程中减少精度损失，避免 quantization error 通过 successive state update 累积。这是 inference-serving × context-engineering × memory 的'recurrent state quantization for linear-attention LLMs'工程化资产——直接把'linear-attention recurrent state'从内存瓶颈变成可量化的工程对象；与昨日 35769 Telescopic LM 'one-model-many-budgets'、35768 PDMD '扩散蒸馏稳定性'同属'inference efficiency'主线，但今日整体把重心从'diffusion 蒸馏 / 多模态反思'移到'linear-attention recurrent state 量化'这条更贴近 production LLM serving 的子主线；GDN/KDA 的命名暴露了方法直接面向 production 部署。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 quantization scheme 形式化、与 GDN/KDA 原生实现的兼容性、quantization-error accumulation 抑制细节。今日动作：即时试点方向，写'leapquant recurrent-state quantization' checklist 草稿；与同批 STEPQuant（38169）形成'方法 × 分析'双联资产。

papers.title: STEPQuant: When and Where Errors Matter in Delta-Rule Recurrent State Quantization
papers.abstract: Linear attention replaces growing KV caches with fixed-size recurrent states, yet these persistent states can become a substantial memory bottleneck under concurrent serving. Directly quantizing recurrent states to low precision often leads to severe accuracy degradation, as quantization errors propagate through successive state updates. We discover that the impact of these errors depends on two complementary dimensions: temporally, errors in long-lived memory can persist across many decoding st
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.38169）：STEPQuant 不直接提出量化方法，而是把 LeapQuant（38166）解决的核心痛点——'quantization error 通过 successive state update 累积导致严重精度退化'——拆成两个互补维度做 analytical understanding：temporally（errors 在 long-lived memory 中跨多 decoding step 持续），spatially（errors 在特定 update step 集中），并相应给出量化策略。这是 inference-serving × context-engineering × llm-evaluation 的'分析驱动的 recurrent state quantization'资产——'when and where errors matter'的分析范式可指导 LeapQuant 的部署工程；与 LeapQuant 同属'linear-attention recurrent state 量化'主线（'方法 vs 分析'双联）；与昨日 35769 Telescopic LM、35768 PDMD 共同加固'inference efficiency'主线。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 error propagation 分析框架、temporal/spatial 维度量化策略的实证。今日动作：即时路线资产，为 LeapQuant 试点提供分析骨架；写'stepquant error-when-where' checklist 草稿。

papers.title: Beyond the Timeline: Augmenting Long-Video Memory with Grounded Entity Biographies
papers.abstract: Answering questions about long videos often requires connecting events involving the same objects across hours or days. Chronological descriptions and text-derived entities can leave physical identity unresolved: different objects may share a description, while observations of the same object remain disconnected across events. Retrieving relevant events therefore does not necessarily recover the "biography" of the particular entity a question concerns. To address this, we introduce Grounded Enti
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.38155）：Beyond the Timeline 解决长视频问答中'同一物体跨小时/跨天识别'的核心痛点——chronological descriptions / text-derived entities 无法解决物理身份（不同物体可能共享描述，同一个对象可能跨事件未被关联）。提出 grounded entity biographies，把每个实体变成 grounded（带视觉证据 + 跨事件追溯）的对象，使 retrieval 不只回事件还能直接回实体。这是 multimodal-agent × context-engineering × rag-knowledge × llm-evaluation 的'grounded entity memory for long video'资产——'entity as first-class object + grounded across time'是与昨日 35759 NstAgent 'narrative state as first-class object' 同源的'memory persistence over long horizon'路线，但 NstAgent 走 narrative state，Beyond the Timeline 走 grounded entity biographies（更视觉、更跨帧）；与 LeapQuant / STEPQuant 'inference efficiency' 主线并列但不同主题。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 entity grounding 协议、biography 更新机制、长视频 QA 评测设置。今日动作：趋势卡片维护，关注'grounded entity memory'路线与 narrative-state 路线的合流可能。

papers.title: Pretraining Latent Information Feedback Transformers with Teacher Supervision
papers.abstract: Transformer language models (LMs) are feed-forward: deep-layer representations are never fed back to shallower layers, and the only pathway for information to flow downward across generation steps is the decoded token. This narrow channel forces models to recompute intermediate results and to discard alternative continuations. In this work, we remove this bottleneck during pretraining, introducing the LIFT (Latent Information Feedback Transformer) architecture and training method which enable LM
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.38149）：Pretraining Latent Information Feedback Transformers 直接打破 Transformer feed-forward 单向信息流——传统 LM 深层表征从不反馈回浅层，跨生成步的下行信息通道只有 decoded token，迫使模型 recompute intermediate results 并丢弃替代续写。该工作把 feedback 在 pretraining 阶段就引入，让浅层直接拿到深层表征。这是 inference-serving × context-engineering 的'feedback-augmented pretraining'架构资产——与 LeapQuant / STEPQuant 'linear-attention recurrent state 量化'同属'打破 Transformer 单向信息流'大主线，但路径不同：前者改 attention state 量化、后者改 pretraining 阶段的层间信息流；与近期 feedback transformer 系列（如 Feedback Transformer）形成延续，但强调 pretraining 而非 inference-time adaptation。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 feedback 形式化、teacher supervision 设计、pretraining cost vs quality 曲线。今日动作：趋势卡片维护，关注'feedback-aware pretraining'路线与 inference-time recurrent state 主线的潜在交集。

papers.title: Imagine3D-LLM: Teaching MLLMs to Imagine 3D Scenes Before Answering
papers.abstract: Reasoning about the 3D world from multi-view images remains a fundamental challenge for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). While modern MLLMs handle single-image inputs effectively, they struggle to integrate evidence across viewpoints into a coherent 3D understanding. A growing body of work attempts to close this gap by injecting 3D awareness into MLLMs, either by boosting fine-grained pixel-level cross-view correspondence or by fusing features from 3D geometry foundation models, yet a s
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.38177）：Imagine3D-LLM 解决 MLLM 从多视图推理 3D 场景的根本挑战——现有方法要么靠 fine-grained pixel-level cross-view correspondence，要么靠融合 3D geometry foundation model 特征，但都没让模型在答前先 imagine 3D scene。该工作让 MLLM 在回答前先生成 3D 场景表征，再基于此做推理。这是 multimodal-agent × llm-evaluation 的'imagine-before-answer for 3D MLLM'资产——长尾保存——'先 imagine 再 answer'的范式可迁移到任何需要多视图融合 / 空间推理的 MLLM 任务；与 LeapQuant / STEPQuant 'inference efficiency' 在主题上不直接同源但同属 MLLM 体系；与 Beyond the Timeline（38155）'grounded entity memory' 在'3D-aware MLLM'层面同源。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 imagine 阶段的 representation 设计、benchmark 规模、3D 推理 baseline。今日动作：沉淀为长尾卡片，标注'imagine-before-answer multimodal'触发条件。

papers.title: A Spectral Theory of Distortion in LLM Graph Reconstruction: Sharp Bounds and Empirical Characterization
papers.abstract: Evaluations of graph reconstruction by language models typically report a single aggregate distance between the original and the reconstructed graph. We prove that for the Wasserstein distance between Laplacian spectra such a summary is bracketed by two edge counts, the net change in edge number from below and the symmetric difference from above, each scaled by $2/n$ where $n$ is the number of vertices. The bracket is sharp: its two ends coincide exactly when the reconstruction only adds edges o
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.38161）：A Spectral Theory of Distortion in LLM Graph Reconstruction 指出当前 LLM 图重构评估的痛点——只报 Wasserstein distance between Laplacian spectra 的单点聚合距离。论文证明该距离被两个 edge count 严格夹住（net change in edge number 从下界、symmetric difference 从上界），均以 2/n 缩放（n 为顶点数），并给出实证刻画。这是 llm-evaluation 的'sharp bounds for LLM graph reconstruction evaluation'理论资产——长尾保存——为团队日后做'LLM 图重构 / 结构化输出评估'提供'Laplacian spectral Wasserstein bracketed by edge counts'具体范式，可直接转化为'图重构评估 rubic'；与 LeapQuant / STEPQuant 'recurrent state quantization' 主线不直接同源但同属'inference-time / 评估时'的方法学资产。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 sharp bound 推导、empirical characterization 协议、与现有 graph reconstruction benchmark 的对照。今日动作：沉淀为长尾卡片，标注'spectral-distortion graph-reconstruction evaluation'触发条件。

papers.title: Breakdown of Local Denoising as Semantic Speciation
papers.abstract: The dynamics of generative models exhibit two apparently distinct temporal windows: a speciation window, in which a sample commits to a semantic class, and a nonlocality window, in which local context windows become insufficient for generation. Motivated by evidence of their near-concurrence in a variety of frontier models, we investigate their relationship through the spatial distribution of semantic information. Under a "common cause" hypothesis, we prove that the nonlocality window must lie i
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.38176）：Breakdown of Local Denoising as Semantic Speciation 在生成模型动力学里识别两个时间窗——speciation window（样本 commit 到语义类的时刻）与 nonlocality window（local context window 不再足以生成）——并在'common cause'假设下证明 nonlocality window 必须落在 speciation window 之内（基于 semantic information 的空间分布）。这是 inference-serving × llm-evaluation 的'生成模型动力学理论统一'资产——长尾保存——为团队日后做'diffusion 步数 vs 语义稳定性'分析提供'speciation-first'具体思路；理论 cs.LG + cond-mat.stat-mech 跨界，与 LeapQuant / STEPQuant 'linear-attention 量化'在方法学层面同源（都涉及 error propagation / state evolution），与昨日 35763 Unifying Distributional Training 'Wasserstein 统一框架'在'theoretical unification of generative dynamics'层面同源。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 common cause 假设形式化、跨生成模型验证。今日动作：沉淀为长尾卡片，标注'speciation-nonlocality generative dynamics'触发条件。

papers.title: Skill-Space Shooting for Autonomous Robot Policy Improvement
papers.abstract: Robots deployed in the physical world must be able to improve beyond their initial training as they encounter new situations and failures. For this improvement to scale across tasks, it must make effective use of experience without requiring human demonstration of each correction. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.38178）：Skill-Space Shooting for Autonomous Robot Policy Improvement 解决物理世界机器人需在初始训练后持续改进、且不能依赖人类对每次修正做示范的痛点。利用 agentic systems 通过 foundation model 自主组合 learned behaviors 完成任务的范式，把 task completion 转成 teachable signal。这是 ai-agent × multimodal-agent 的'skill-space self-improvement'资产——长尾保存——'skill space as optimization target + agentic composition'的具体范式可迁移到任意长程 agent 任务；与昨日 35760 TokenCast'agent cost governance'、35759 NstAgent 'narrative state'同属'agent production 治理'路线但更偏向 robotics 落地；与 LeapQuant / STEPQuant 'linear-attention quantization' 在主题上不同但同属'LLM-era agent 基础设施'。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 skill space 定义、shooting 算法、跨任务迁移验证、cs.RO 标准 benchmark。今日动作：沉淀为长尾卡片，标注'skill-space shooting agent self-improvement'触发条件；持续观察是否开源 + 是否能在 LLM agent（非物理机器人）上做迁移。
